comment: OA controller profiles for the MENU poller (Web Gamepad API). Controller Identity arc Phase 2. Indices are Web-Gamepad-API RAW indices (buttons[] / axes[]), NOT SDL gamecontrollerdb joystick numbers (D12). A profile is applied ONLY when the browser reports a non-standard mapping ('' rather than 'standard'); standard pads already arrive canonical. Keyed by device-key (see deviceKey.ts). Button names are CANONICAL (south/east/west/north = SDL/Xbox positions); the canonical->NavButton table lives in controllerProfiles.ts. dpad maps a direction to a raw button index; omit it when the pad reports its DPad as a HAT axis and set hatAxis instead. Phase 3's wizard appends entries here (later: a runtime override layer in appDataDir merges over this bundled seed).

profiles.name: Switch Pro Controller (wired / non-standard HID)
profiles.note: Seeded from the standard Switch Pro HID button order as a prior. The operator's pad is a third-party wired 'Faceoff' Switch Pro whose DPad reports as a HAT on axis 9 (see reference_hid_hat_axis_decoding). Face/shoulder indices below are UNVERIFIED — confirm via a press-each-button capture and correct before clearing the flag.
